articles.title: Iran targets Bahrain twice after months of quiet, claiming retaliation against U.S.
articles.description: ABU DHABI, United Arab Emirates - Sirens sounded, and explosions were heard in Bahrain on Sunday in an attack Iran said targeted U.S. military equipment at a helicopter base in retaliation for American strikes in Iran. Bahrain, home to the U.S. Fifth Fleet Navy base, was targeted by hundreds of Iranian drones and missiles during the first months of the war, but had been relative quiet recently.
